decided: The program's sign-off question names the program and the copy of its brief, offers exactly two answers, sign off or decline, and on a decline asks for the user's reason in their own words: the same question the archive asks about one change.
alternatives: offer a third answer that puts the question off without recording anything
ask the question with different wording from the archive's
why: The user answers one kind of sign-off question wherever it is asked, and putting it off already happens by declining or by not opening the next session.

relies_on.title: The archive holds for a per-change sign-off
